packet.description_seed: South Africa and Mamelodi Sundowns midfielder Jayden Adams dies at the age of 25, just weeks after featuring for his country at the World Cup.

clean_source_blocks.text: South Africa and Mamelodi Sundowns midfielder Jayden Adams dies at the age of 25, just weeks after featuring for his country at the World Cup.

South Africa and Mamelodi Sundowns midfielder Jayden Adams has died at the age of 25, just weeks after featuring for his country at the World Cup. Adams featured in all three of South Africa's group games at the tournament, where they reached the knockout stages before losing to co-hosts Canada in the round of 32. "It is with profound shock and a heavy heart that I have learnt of the passing of Jayden Adams," South Africa's minister of sport, arts and culture Gayton McKenzie said, in a statement. "South African football has lost one of its brightest young talents, and our nation mourns alongside his family, his team-mates and the millions of supporters who watched him grow from a promising academy prospect into a full Bafana Bafana international."

South African football has been plunged into mourning following reports that Bafana Bafana and Mamelodi Sundowns midfielder Jayden Adams has died at the age of 25, just days after returning from the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The talented midfielder was part of South Africa's historic World Cup campaign, making three appearances as Bafana Bafana progressed to the Round of 32 before bowing out to co-hosts Canada. Adams' performances in the tournament further highlighted his growing importance to both club and country and cemented his reputation as one of South Africa's brightest midfield talents. Adams joined Mamelodi Sundowns after establishing himself as one of the standout players in the South African Premier Division during his time with Stellenbosch FC.

South Africa star Jayden Adams has died aged 25 - just days after playing at the World Cup. The shocking news was reported by South African outlet Soccer Laduma on Saturday. A cause of death hasn't been announced at this time. The South African Football Association (SAFA) has yet to comment on Adams' passing. Adams was part of South Africa's squad for this year's World Cup, helping the country reach the knockout stages of the tournament. The midfielder played in all three of South Africa's group-stage games against Mexico, the Czech Republic, and South Korea. He didn't feature in the round-of-32 defeat to Canada.

[Lähde: Dublin Live]
South Africa star Jayden Adams has died aged 25 - just days after playing at the World Cup.

The shocking news was reported by South African outlet Soccer Laduma on Saturday. A cause of death hasn't been announced at this time.

The South African Football Association (SAFA) has yet to comment on Adams' passing. Adams was part of South Africa's squad for this year's World Cup, helping the country reach the knockout stages of the tournament.

The midfielder played in all three of South Africa's group-stage games against Mexico, the Czech Republic, and South Korea. He didn't feature in the round-of-32 defeat to Canada.

Adams won nine senior caps for South Africa. At the club level, he began his career at Stellenbosch before joining Mamelodi Sundowns, one of the top teams in South Africa, last year. Adams played the full 180 minutes across both legs as the Sundowns beat AS FAR of Morocco to win their second CAF Champions League title in May.

Brendine Johnson, who was Adams' mentor, has spoken on the player's shock death. As quoted by Soccer Laduma, he said: "At this moment, things are still raw, you know, things are still raw. The family wouldn't want to be contacted right now; they wouldn't be able to answer anyone. This passing has ripped everybody apart, returning from the World Cup just now, and then got such news, you know.

"I had a close conversation with him on Thursday, the guy was really positive on returning back and being able to return after the World Cup and go, you know, being a CAF champion, knowing what lies ahead, he was prepared. He doesn't waste time away, being at home with his family. So at this moment, I don't even have words to say, but we ask that the family's privacy be respected.

"Yes, I can tell you that he passed on. Nobody expected this." Just last month, SAFA released a statement following the death of Adams' grandmother, Marianna.

She passed away while her grandson was playing at the World Cup.. "This is a massive loss for Jayden's family, friends and relatives, and we join in mourning the loss of his grandmother. We as SAFA offer our deepest condolences and may her soul Rest in Peace," said Danny Jordaan, SAFA's president, in a statement.

payload.title: Etelä-Afrikan maajoukkuepelaaja Jayden Adams on kuollut 25-vuotiaana
payload.summary: Mamelodi Sundownsin keskikenttäpelaaja Jayden Adams on kuollut pian sen jälkeen, kun hän edusti Etelä-Afrikkaa jalkapallon MM-kisoissa. Kuolinsyytä ei ole kerrottu.
payload.content:
Etelä-Afrikan jalkapallomaajoukkueessa ja Mamelodi Sundownsissa pelannut keskikenttäpelaaja Jayden Adams on kuollut 25-vuotiaana. Hän oli palannut vain vähän aikaa aiemmin vuoden 2026 MM-kisoista, joissa Etelä-Afrikka eteni alkulohkosta 32 parhaan joukkueen pudotuspelivaiheeseen. Tieto kuolemasta tuli julkisuuteen lauantaina.

## Adams pelasi kaikissa alkulohko-otteluissa

Adams kuului Etelä-Afrikan MM-kisajoukkueeseen ja pelasi sen kaikissa kolmessa alkulohko-ottelussa. Bafana Bafana kohtasi turnauksen lohkovaiheessa Meksikon, Tšekin ja Etelä-Korean. Etelä-Afrikka selviytyi tulostensa ansiosta jatkoon, mutta sen kisataival päättyi ensimmäisellä pudotuspelikierroksella tappioon Kanadaa vastaan. Adams ei pelannut 32 parhaan kierroksen ottelussa.

Kolme esiintymistä MM-turnauksessa korostivat Adamsin kasvavaa merkitystä Etelä-Afrikan maajoukkueelle. Hän oli noussut lupaavasta akatemiapelaajasta maan pääsarjan huomattavien keskikenttäpelaajien joukkoon ja edelleen täydeksi Etelä-Afrikan A-maajoukkuepelaajaksi. Adams vakiinnutti ensin asemaansa Stellenbosch FC:ssä, jossa hänen esityksensä nostivat hänet Etelä-Afrikan pääsarjan erottuvien pelaajien joukkoon. Myöhemmin hän siirtyi Mamelodi Sundownsiin.

## Ministeri kuvaili menetystä järkyttäväksi

Etelä-Afrikan urheilu-, taide- ja kulttuuriministeri Gayton McKenzie sanoi tiedotteessaan vastaanottaneensa tiedon Adamsin kuolemasta syvästi järkyttyneenä ja raskain mielin. McKenzien mukaan eteläafrikkalainen jalkapallo menetti yhden kirkkaimmista nuorista lahjakkuuksistaan. Hän totesi koko maan surevan Adamsin perheen, joukkuetovereiden ja niiden miljoonien kannattajien rinnalla, jotka olivat seuranneet pelaajan kehitystä akatemialupauksesta Bafana Bafanan maajoukkuepelaajaksi.

Kuolinsyytä ei ole ilmoitettu. Etelä-Afrikan jalkapalloliitto SAFA ei myöskään ollut kommentoinut Adamsin kuolemaa ensimmäisten uutistietojen julkaisuhetkellä. Ensimmäiset tiedot tapauksesta perustuivat eteläafrikkalaisen Soccer Laduma -julkaisun lauantaina julkaisemaan uutiseen.

Adamsin kuolema sattui vain päiviä tai viikkoja sen jälkeen, kun hän oli edustanut maataan MM-kisoissa. Turnauksessa hän osallistui jokaiseen Etelä-Afrikan alkulohko-otteluun ja oli mukana joukkueessa, joka eteni pudotuspeleihin asti. Hänen esitystensä katsottiin vahvistaneen hänen mainettaan yhtenä Etelä-Afrikan lupaavimmista nuorista keskikenttäpelaajista sekä seura- että maajoukkuetasolla.
summary_bullets: Hän pelasi kaikissa Etelä-Afrikan kolmessa alkulohko-ottelussa vuoden 2026 MM-kisoissa.
payload.journalist_note: Kuolinsyytä ei ole julkistettu, eikä Etelä-Afrikan jalkapalloliitto ollut kommentoinut tapausta ensimmäisten tietojen julkaisuhetkellä.
